World Bank Global Findex puts Cote d'Ivoire's financial inclusion rate at 58% in 2024, up from 41% in 2017.
ARTCI's MSI 2024 survey finds 50.3% of individuals aged 5 and over hold a personal mobile money account, over 13 million people (men 55.4%, women 45.1%); the base is not adults.
Afriveille, reading Global Findex 2024, says 58% of Ivorian adults hold an account, up from 51% in 2021, with mobile money at 53% and bank accounts at 21%.
The brief, citing Global Findex 2021, says 79% of adults had an account in 2021.
